report.status_line: Caution: Broken and loose helmet latches, empty ATV fuel containers, and blocked water flow meter filter.

concerns.title: EVA Helmet Latch Failures and Visor Fogging
concerns.detail: During EVA preparation and maintenance, the crew identified that the rear latch on helmet 6 is broken, the rear latch on helmet 2/3 does not snap into place and must be taped to secure connection, and some other helmet latches do not properly attach to suits. The crew also reported issues with visor fogging during EVAs.

concerns.title: Blocked Water Flow Meter Filter and Water Status
concerns.detail: The crew removed the water flow meter located between the loft tank valve and the pump and found a blocked filter. In addition, 4 days have elapsed since the 2015-01-17 static tank refill, with static tank level measuring 20 cm from the top and dropping ~2.3 cm/day. Total water volume remaining is unknown; estimated draw since refill is 339.36 L at FMARS average rate (12.12 L/person/day) and 70 L at NASA minimum (2.5 L/person/day).

concerns.title: ATV Gasoline Supply Depleted
concerns.detail: Following ATV refueling, both containers of gasoline are now empty, leaving no reserve gasoline for vehicles for the remaining 2 days of the mission.

crew_actions: Clean or replace the blocked water flow meter filter and reassemble the pump line.
Provide a new total water volume estimate, as the static tank was refilled on 2015-01-17 and total water remaining is unknown.
Remove helmet 6 from EVA service, and ensure loose latches on helmet 2/3 and other helmets are firmly taped and verified prior to airlock depressurization.
Apply anti-fogging mitigation to helmet visors before all upcoming EVAs.

decisions_for_earth.decision: Authorize EVA helmet latch workaround protocols (including taping loose latches and taking helmet 6 out of service) or restrict EVA operations.
decisions_for_earth.why: Helmet 6 has a broken rear latch and helmet 2/3 requires tape to stay fastened, posing potential suit integrity risks.

decisions_for_earth.decision: Approve restricting remaining mission EVAs to walking only, or evaluate emergency gasoline resupply.
decisions_for_earth.why: Both gasoline containers are empty with 2 days remaining until scheduled mission end on 2015-01-23.

report.message_to_earth:
STATUS: Operations are at caution due to degraded helmet latches and empty gasoline containers.
WHAT HAPPENED: On 2015-01-21, crew found helmet 6 rear latch broken, helmet 2/3 latch loose, and both gasoline containers empty after refueling ATVs. A blocked filter was also found in the water flow meter.
WHAT THE CREW IS DOING: Crew secured helmet 2/3 with tape and removed the water flow meter to clear the filter.
OTHER SYSTEMS: Diesel is nominal at 60%, propane is 32%, and static water tank measures 20 cm from top.
REQUEST: Approve helmet taping protocols and walking-only EVAs by tomorrow morning.
NEXT UPDATE: Next report tomorrow evening.
